details.completeness_justification: K1-K4 and K6 are fully covered. K5 is only partially covered because the candidate mentions the reclassification and net debt figure but omits the explicit link to covenant breach resolution. K7 is only partially covered because the candidate reports the dividend amount but omits the General Meeting approval of the 2025 financial statements.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. Each sentence builds logically on the previous ones: revenue and volume drivers (S2) explain the revenue increase (S1), the collapse in balancing income (S3) is consistent with the operating-expense reduction (S4), and the resulting EBITDA and profit growth (S5–S6) follow directly. The contrast between reported and adjusted EBITDA (S7) is clearly explained as timing/regulatory effects. Balance-sheet movements (S8–S12) are presented in a sequential, cause-and-effect manner, and cash-flow and equity changes (S13–S15) align with the profit and dividend information (S16). No self-contradictions, logical gaps, or unnecessary repetitions are present.
